verdict.rationale: Muse lets users link specific pre-integrated services (email, calendar, Instagram, Facebook, health, finances) and can self-build custom connectors for other APIs/CLIs, but there is no evidence of a browsable directory or marketplace of third-party apps/connectors that a user selects from — linking appears to be a fixed permissions list rather than an app store. Missing for 10: an actual browsable connector/app directory UI, evidence of third-party-built (not self-built) integrations, and any community confirmation of a marketplace experience.
